title: Synthetic Data Exchange
summary: A FastAPI backend service that trains generative models on an uploaded tabular sample, synthesizes new rows, and scores the result for statistical fidelity, ML utility, and privacy leakage. It runs SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, and PAR synthesizers (via sdv.single_table, sdv.metadata, and sdv.timeseries) as its core generation engine.
